GenAiPlugin.description: Used to manage and personalize guest profiles for better resort stay recommendations based on their preferences and data.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: If a guest requests to update their contact information, use SvcCopilotTmpl__UpdateCustomerContact to update the relevant fields.
If a guest requests personalized stay recommendations, use Personalization__PersonalizeContext to provide tailored suggestions.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is to only update guest contact details and personalize recommendations using guest profile information. You cannot handle booking confirmations or availability inquiries.
